title: Agora UI for cited data and clarification and habits and paper book and imitation and reports

runtime_budget.notes: Frontend Agora UI consuming existing BFF v1.13/v1.14 servant and trading-room endpoints; adds no recurring job, emitter, or persistent writer.

acceptance_coverage.AC1: All new text is zh-TW (via src/i18n/locales/zh-TW.ts with exact key parity in src/i18n/locales/en-US.ts enforced by src/agora/i18n.guard.test.ts). Citations (source, as_of, freshness) and stated assumptions are rendered under each servant answer in both the 交易僕人任務 drawer command task history ([data-testid='servant-answer-citations'], [data-testid='servant-stated-assumptions']) and the session message stream ([data-testid^='servant-stream-citations-']).
acceptance_coverage.AC2: Single-question clarification cards ([data-testid='servant-clarification-card']) display question, why_it_matters, servant_default, and clickable option buttons ([data-testid^='servant-clarification-option-']) that send clarification_choice (decision_id, question_id, option_id, selected_option_id, option_label, resolves) back via POST /bff/agora/servant/sessions/{session_id}/messages and confirm the choice ([data-testid='servant-clarification-selected']).
acceptance_coverage.AC3: The trader habits view ([data-testid='personalization-servant-habits-section']) in the 個人化紀錄 drawer reads GET /bff/agora/servant/habits, displays the 7 deterministic habit features with sample sizes (sample_size/min_sample) and 樣本不足 labels when below min_sample, shows private servant interpretations (persona_private), and lets the trader reject, replace, or add habit rules via PATCH /bff/agora/servant/habits with immediate readback confirmation ([data-testid='servant-habit-correction-saved']).
acceptance_coverage.AC4: Paper fills and positions from GET /bff/agora/trading-room/paper-book are rendered in PositionActionQueue ([data-testid='position-action-queue'], [data-testid='paper-book-positions-list'], [data-testid='paper-book-fills-list']) and on Strategy Performance ([data-testid='performance-paper-book-section']) with pantheon_paper_proxy ([data-testid='paper-book-proxy-badge']), agora_paper_book_readback_only ([data-testid='paper-book-no-order-action']), and zero order buttons.
acceptance_coverage.AC5: 「僕人模仿您」 ([data-testid='performance-servant-imitation-section']) on Strategy Performance reads GET /bff/agora/trading-room/imitation-comparison and renders agreement rate, outcome gap, 1,000-resample 95% bootstrap confidence intervals ([data-testid='imitation-agreement-rate-interval'], [data-testid='imitation-outcome-gap-interval']), the explicit luck label 可能是運氣 ([data-testid='imitation-outcome-gap-luck-label']) when an interval contains zero, and the decision differences table ([data-testid='imitation-differences-list']).
acceptance_coverage.AC6: Report history ([data-testid='performance-trader-reports-section'], [data-testid='trader-report-history-list']) and a compact drawer report card ([data-testid='servant-drawer-report-card']) read GET /bff/agora/servant/reports, display report narrative ([data-testid='trader-report-narrative']), cited owner facts with owner/source/as_of ([data-testid='trader-report-citations']), suggested next steps ([data-testid='trader-report-suggestions']), daily quota ([data-testid='trader-reports-quota']), and request on-demand reports via POST /bff/agora/servant/reports ([data-testid='request-trader-report-btn']).
acceptance_coverage.AC7: The persona consult control ([data-testid='servant-optional-persona-consult-control'], [data-testid='servant-open-optional-persona-consult']) is optional and off by default; both unit tests and Playwright E2E prove that a full default flow (ask with data citations, clarification choice, habits read/correct, paper book readback, 僕人模仿您 comparison, report request) makes zero persona_opinion and zero meeting calls and zero /bff/management calls (SD §10).
acceptance_coverage.AC8: Real Chromium Playwright browser proof (e2e/agora-servant-core-hosted.spec.ts) against the built SPA with recorded fixtures and hosted dev trader (admintest) walkthrough specification, with 6 screenshots captured under docs/deployment/evidence/FE-AGORA-SERVANT-CORE-20261127/screenshots/. Hosted dev FE currently serves commit 0a0ce540597647809dc0c0f2886cfc376d73c025 (pre-merge); re-run hosted walkthrough after this PR merges to dev and deploys.
